PREFIX schema: <http://schema.org/>
PREFIX luc: <http://www.ontotext.com/connectors/lucene#>
PREFIX luc-index: <http://www.ontotext.com/connectors/lucene/instance#>
SELECT ?company ?name ?locality WHERE { GRAPH <https://lindas.admin.ch/foj/zefix> {
  ?company a <https://schema.ld.admin.ch/ZefixOrganisation> ; schema:legalName ?name ; schema:address ?a . ?a schema:addressLocality ?locality .
  FILTER(CONTAINS(LCASE(?name), "alpenglanz"))
} } LIMIT 25
